long_biography.plain_text:
Paolo Montanaro built MV Line around the idea that a utilitarian building component could become a designed industrial product. He moved the company from assembling aluminium and steel roller systems towards in-house prototype development and production, combining easier operation and installation with closer integration into windows and façades. That product-led approach became the organising principle of the wider group.

Montanaro has remained president of MV Line Group and its sole director while extending the business across insect screens, roller blinds and solar-shading systems. His industry role broadened through Assotende, where he joined the governing council and became president for the 2026–2030 term. The appointment placed him at the head of the Italian trade body for blinds, solar shading, automation and technical fabrics.
